heading: Performance indicators
reported_value: CR = ([M]in - [M]out)/[M]in x 100 with concentrations (%); EDE = converted CO2 flow (L/min) / IEP (W); CO selectivity = [CO]pg / ([CH4]cp + [CO2]cp)

notes: For pure CO2, CR = 100 - y_CO2,out (dry %); this overstates conversion when the gas expands (CO2 -> CO + 1/2 O2) or is diluted

heading: Performance indicators

heading: Scope
reported_value: max CR 34.5% with CH4 (Case 2, CH4/CO2 0.65); 7.8% with H2O (Case 3); 43% with CH4 + H2O (Case 4); all at 0.6 kW, 14 L/min total; CH4 from CNG (88.9% CH4)
evidence_excerpt_or_description: The maximum carbon dioxide conversion rate was 12.3 % when pure carbon dioxide was supplied; 34.5 % when methane was injected ... 43 % when methane and steam were injected together
notes: CH4/H2O co-feeds are out of scope (objectives: scope); not extracted further
